searchText: Hi. Dumb question here too: kzg-wasm is intended for browser execution, correct? Just discovered it but getting import errors Yes, I rolled it as a stop-gap for usage in the ethereumjs libraries since we intend for our libraries to be browser compatible. Unfortunately, it's not perfect and the `emscripten` toolchain I used has a lot of very unclear documentation It work under the `vite` framework though I'm aware of nextjs complaining when you try to import it. Will be looking more at that incompatibility in coming days/weeks I understand that beacon blocks are propagated with compression - are blob sidecars propagated with compression as well?
